stem: A crop-treatment record lists the date and product but not the room, lot, applicator, rate, or verification details. What is the strongest quality concern?
choices: The record cannot reliably reconstruct the event or link it to the affected crop, so traceability and deviation investigation are weakened
The record is complete because date and product are enough for every purpose
Missing identifiers matter only for financial reports
The details can always be reconstructed from memory later
rationale: Operational records need enough contextual identifiers and execution details to support traceability, verification, and later investigation.
